# Project Settings {#sec-project-settings}

The **Project Settings** dialog manages the settings for the current project.
These settings are saved with the project.
To open it, click the **File** tab and select **Settings**.

## General {#sec-project-settings-general}

The options on this page manage the project's general settings.

### Project {-}

**Project name**: Enter the name of the project.
This is used as the title when the project is exported.

**Subject**: Enter the subject of the project.

**Author**: Enter the author of the project.

**Keywords**: Enter keywords that describe the project.

::: {.notesection data-latex=""}
The name, subject, author, and keywords are also used as the document information when [exporting](#sec-exporting) the project.
:::

**Auto-refresh when data files change**: Check this option to have the project watch its datasets' files and reload them when they change.
This can also be toggled with the `r keys("Auto Refresh")` button in the **Pages** section of the **Home** tab.

::: {.notesection data-latex=""}
Auto refresh is only available when all of a project's datasets are imported from local files.
:::

## Export & Printing {#sec-project-settings-printing}

The options on this page control how the project is printed and exported.

### Headers & Footers {-}

**Headers & Footers...**: Click this button to open the [**Printer Headers & Footers**](#sec-printer-headers-footers) dialog.

### Watermark {-}

A watermark is a label drawn across each page when the project is printed or exported.
It is not shown on the pages in the program.

**Text**: Enter the text of the watermark.
Leave this empty to not include a watermark.

**Color**: Select the color of the watermark.

\newpage

## Printer Headers & Footers {#sec-printer-headers-footers}

This dialog specifies the headers and footers that are included when the project is printed or exported.

### Headers {-}

**Left**: Enter the text to show in the upper-left corner of each page.

**Center**: Enter the text to show in the top center of each page.

**Right**: Enter the text to show in the upper-right corner of each page.

### Footers {-}

**Left**: Enter the text to show in the lower-left corner of each page.

**Center**: Enter the text to show in the bottom center of each page.

**Right**: Enter the text to show in the lower-right corner of each page.

### Tags {-}

Headers and footers can include the following tags, which are replaced when the pages are printed:

- `@TITLE@`: The title of the printed document.
- `@DATE@`: The date when it was printed.
- `@TIME@`: The time when it was printed.
- `@DATETIME@`: The date and time when it was printed.
- `@PAGENUM@`: The current page number.
- `@PAGESCNT@`: The number of printed pages.
- `@USER@`: The user's name.

For example, `Page @PAGENUM@ of @PAGESCNT@` would be shown as *Page 2 of 5* on the second page of a five-page printout.

Each field's drop-down list includes these tags (and some common combinations of them) to select from.

::: {.warningsection data-latex=""}
Any other text enclosed in *@* symbols (e.g., `@PAGE@`) is not a valid tag.
An error will be shown if an invalid tag is entered.
:::
